correctness.rationale: The blow-up description produces 27 exceptional line classes and all 36 opposite-paired E6 roots; 12 nonzero-pairing line classes form each double-six. Their divisor sum equals four times the anticanonical class, so the incidence image lies in the rank-21 primitive anticanonical kernel. An exact 27-by-36 Gram computation gives rational rank 21. Six line classes give a unimodular quotient basis; retaining the other 21 line coordinates identifies that kernel integrally. The resulting 21-by-36 matrix has mod-2 rank 6, a specifically indexed full-rank minor of determinant -65536, and a primitive integer row covector evaluating -4 on all 36 columns. These facts bound the image index above and below by 2^16 and force the nonzero invariant factors 1^6,2^14,4. The bundled standard-library verifier rebuilt the matrix from the geometric classes and reproduced every certificate and VERIFY_OK. The theorem is confined to formal line-incidence lattices, not Picard torsion.
